# Function determineAgentForResumption

  * determineAgentForResumption(  
session: [Session](../interfaces/Session.html),  
rootAgent: [BaseAgent](../classes/BaseAgent.html),  
resumabilityConfig?: [ResumabilityConfig](../interfaces/ResumabilityConfig.html),  
): [BaseAgent](../classes/BaseAgent.html)

Determines the next agent to run to continue the session. This is primarily used for session resumption across tool and LRO boundaries.

#### Parameters

    * session: [Session](../interfaces/Session.html)
    * rootAgent: [BaseAgent](../classes/BaseAgent.html)
    * `Optional`resumabilityConfig: [ResumabilityConfig](../interfaces/ResumabilityConfig.html)
